checks_passed.what_was_verified: Recomputed both examples from the printed masses and from molecular weights derived atom by atom, without reading the provenance's conclusion first. Example 1: 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid is C9H9ClO4S, MW 248.68, so 100 g is 0.40213 mol; the product C9H8BrClO4S is MW 327.57, so theory is 131.73 g; 121.3 g at the printed 96% purity is 116.45 g, which is 88.401% against the 88.4% printed at line 124. Example 2: C10H11ClO4S, MW 262.70, 20 g is 0.07613 mol; product C10H10BrClO4S, MW 341.60, theory 26.006 g; 28.2 g at the printed 88% purity is 24.82 g, which is 95.42% against the 95.6% printed at line 140. The residual 0.18 points is rounding on the printed purity: 88.16% would reproduce 95.6% exactly. Both close. mass_balance_implausible and molar_mass_inconsistent are correctly absent from both records and their absence is not a missing flag.

Established independently that both printed yields are purity-corrected, and that the two examples are consistent with each other on that point. Uncorrected, Example 1's 121.3 g would be 92.08% and Example 2's 28.2 g would be 108.43% of theory, the second of which is impossible on the stated charge. Applying the printed HPLC purity to each reproduces the printed figure in both. No third convention appears anywhere in the patent.

Reagent stoichiometry checked for plausibility against the substrate charge, none of it stated by the patent and none of it written into the artifact: Example 1 has 1.200 eq N-bromosuccinimide, 0.041 eq bromine and 0.100 eq azoisobutyronitrile; Example 2 has 1.299 eq N-bromosuccinimide and 0.152 eq dibenzoyl peroxide over four portions. Nothing exceeds what the substrate could consume and nothing is sub-stoichiometric in a way the text does not support.

Step-to-step continuity: there is no chain to check. Example 1's two records are Process Variants A and B, separate charges of purchased substrate in separate vessels, and Example 2 starts from a different substrate. Background Steps 2 and 3 are a genuine two-stage chain but the patent prints no mass for either. scale_discontinuity is correctly unraised on all thirteen records.

reactant_smiles, smiles_source, product_smiles, product_smiles_source and canonical_rxn are null on all thirteen records. No molecular formula, no molecular weight and no computed mole figure appears in any structured field; the only derived number anywhere in the data is the 2.8 g dibenzoyl peroxide total raised as a finding above.

conditions.atmosphere is null on all thirteen records and the patent names no atmosphere. pressure.type is not_specified on all thirteen, with the reduced pressure of Example 1's drying and Example 2's concentration correctly held as workup rather than as a reaction pressure. cooling_method, concentration, ph_value and ph_target_stage are null throughout, and stirring is left null on the two records whose text says only that the apparatus was stirred. No condition reads as a default.

No stated temperature range is flattened to a point. Claims_Step 1 and Claims_Step 2 hold 70 to 100 C as a range from claims 11 and 17; Process Conditions holds 40 to 100 C as a range from [0015]; Example 1_Step 1's 90 C is a point the page prints as a point. Reflux is recorded as heating_method and never as a temperature, on all five records where the text says reflux, and temperature stays not_specified on the three of those that print no number.

The one asserted link is substantiated. Background_Step 3 names precursor_step Step 2 with linkage_confirmed true, and Step 2's product identifier, methyl 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, is literally Step 3's reactant identifier, with the text referring back at line 55 in the words "is then obtained from this latter compound by hydrolysis". No other genuine link exists to have been missed: this patent is one transformation, the two process variants are alternatives rather than a sequence, and the two examples start from different substrates, so precursor_step null on the other twelve records is correct rather than a gap.

Counted the transformations in the source independently, section by section: abstract 1, background 3 (the WO 99/06339 disclosure, the EP-A 0 292 944 ester bromination and its hydrolysis), summary 2 (variants A and B), process conditions 2, example 1 two (variants A and B), example 2 one, claims 2 (independent claims 6 and 13). Thirteen, against thirteen records. The Houben-Weyl sentence at line 55 was weighed as a possible fourth background record and rejected on the same grounds the record states: it cites a handbook chapter, discloses no process, names no substrate or reagent, and the next sentence withdraws it. Claims 1 to 5 are cancelled and claims 19 and 20 are compound claims, so neither yields a reaction.

Washes, quenches and drying checked explicitly rather than skimmed. Example 1's cooling, 100 ml of 2% sodium bisulfite, 400 ml of water, filtration, unnamed wash and drying at 60 C under reduced pressure are all on the record; Example 2's cooling, sodium bisulfite, 300 ml ethyl acetate, phase separation, unnamed wash, concentration under reduced pressure and the diethyl ether and heptane trituration are all on the record. Neither example names a drying agent and neither record invents one. The unnamed wash media are recorded as unnamed rather than assumed to be water.

The as-printed and EN lines diverge in five places and the artifact followed the as-printed line in procedure_text every time, while using the repaired spelling as the identifier and saying so in notes: N-bromosuccimide at L154, sulfonylmethyl and sulfonylethyl at L122, L130 and L140, 1 I and 0.5 I for the litre unit at L122 and L140, 3-methyl4- and 2-chloro4- missing hyphens at L57, L110 and L124, and II g of bromine at L130. procedure_text for the three example records was diffed character for character against the as-printed source lines with only the paragraph marker removed, and matched exactly. The page prints "with a 300 W lamp, II g of bromine were gradually metered in over 3 h", and the two glyphs carry symmetric top and bottom serifs, unlike the digit 1 in "1 I stirred apparatus" and "100g" three paragraphs above on the same page and in the same face. The reading is capital I, not 11. Example 1_Step 2 leaving compounds[bromine].quantity.mass_g null and substituting no number is the correct treatment, and mass_balance_implausible is correctly not raised, because the value is absent rather than implausible.

Opened p01 to p04. There are nine drawings on the four pages: one in the abstract, two at [0004] and [0005], one at [0020], two inside claim 6, two inside claim 13 and one at claim 19. The enriched markdown carries exactly nine IMAGE_EXTRACT spans, at L42, L61, L65, L102, L144, L146, L177, L179 and L193, so none is lost. Read the substituent positions off the page rather than inferring them.
